description: baseline transmission rate (per week); R0_peak = beta_base*(1+beta_season)/gamma_rate
source: Biggerstaff 2014 BMC Infect Dis (seasonal flu R0 median 1.28, IQR 1.19-1.37; central beta_base = 1.28*1.75 = 2.24)
Eales 2025 PLoS Comput Biol (beta1 = 0.25, calibrated to peak-week SD ~3.5 wks and attack rate ~20%); Towers 2012 lecture notes (relative seasonal forcing ~20-30%)
Ng 2021 Virol Sin (Macau Kiang Wu Hospital 2010-2018; influenza A peaks Jan-Feb; influenza B peaks Mar-May); CHP HK surveillance

description: 1/latent period (per week); approximated by incubation period
source: Lessler 2009 Lancet Infect Dis (influenza A incubation period median 1.4 d, 95% CI 1.3-1.5; 95th percentile 2.8 d; latent period in SEIRS approximated by incubation period)
Carrat 2008 Am J Epidemiol (mean viral shedding 4.8 d, 95% CI 4.3-5.3; illness duration 3.7-5.0 d; we use 4 d as a conservative central estimate for infectious period)
